FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Everlasting Vows Chapel, we specialize in providing elegant wedding ceremonies tailored to each couple's unique vision. Our chapel is designed for intimate gatherings, accommodating up to 100 guests to ensure a personal experience. We offer a full range of wedding services including on-site coordination, décor, floral arrangements, and professional photography, all while ensuring compliance with local regulations and maintaining a formal risk management plan. Our dedicated team collaborates closely with clients to create unforgettable moments, and we only work with licensed vendors to guarantee quality and safety. With a commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction, we are proud to facilitate beautiful weddings in a serene environment, without hosting receptions or serving alcohol on the premises.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No reported losses to date; business commenced operations on 01/15/2020; maintaining adherence to prescribed safety and operational standards.
